reader.requirement: At --std 85 the operand of TYPE CONTROL HEADING / CONTROL FOOTING (a data-name or FINAL, required by the 1985 format, with no ON/FOR and no OR PAGE) must be refused unless it is one of the data-names or FINAL of the same RD's CONTROL clause, including when the RD has no CONTROL clause.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ReportControlOperandForms2002: refuses at 85 a CH/CF with no operand and the OR PAGE phrase (COBOL0900)
refuses the ON/FOR word at 85 (COBOL0900); GateCobol85ControlName refuses a reference-modified operand at 85 (ReportControlReferenceModification2002)
no edition test in the CH/CF level resolution; the omitted-operand arm (Controls.Count == 1 ? 0) is reached only where the 2002 form is admitted

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 2002+ the operand may be omitted with a one-operand CONTROL clause, may be preceded by ON/FOR, and a control heading may carry OR PAGE; at 85 each is refused by COBOL0900. The SR2 membership test (COBOL0899) is the same code at every edition.

reader.notes: Every operand that the 1985 format admits is resolved against the CONTROL hierarchy and refused with COBOL0899 when it is not one of its entries; the 2002 forms are refused at 85 by VersionConformancePass before the shared omitted-operand arm can be reached. Minor: COBOL0899 is positioned at the RD line, not the group entry (p3a reports (15,8) for the entry on line 16).
